checks.description: Defaults List item/medium/none/right/enabled/unselected; root/content required, secondary/icon/selectedIcon/avatar/trailing optional with owned Pressable/ref surface.
Omitted optional slots do not manufacture content except documented default content; default root remains button with false disabled/selected.
Optional FocusRing then selection glyph then CompoundItemLayout; leading avatar takes precedence over selectedIcon/icon, active icon precedes stable primary, secondary and trailing content.
Selected true swaps to selectedIcon, hides regular icon and uses invisible semibold reservation beneath selected visible text.

tests.name: ListItem uses selected semantics, selected icon, and a ghost label to prevent reflow

checks.description: Unselected uses regular icon; selected without selectedIcon falls back to regular icon; absent visuals and custom slots preserve props.
Press forwards once without changing externally owned selected=false.

tests.name: ListItem renders selection without changing it on press

checks.description: none has no glyph; single false/true uses open/filled radio glyph; multiple false/true uses unchecked/checked glyph, all inaccessible.
Selected multiple suppresses row fill; disabled suppresses fill in every selection mode; other selected rows reserve semibold width and show soft neutral fill.
Native selection weight changes do not move surrounding content across constraints and text scaling.
Disabled is unfocusable, exposes disabled/selected false and ignores synthetic press.

tests.name: ListItem disables interaction and exposes disabled accessibility state

checks.description: Disabled overrides hover/press, pressed wins hover, selected-fill state retains documented token variants, user root style follows all layers and caller handlers compose.
Caller state merges with disabled/selected, visible content or caller name labels default button; leading/trailing/indicator visuals stay decorative.
Native Enter/Space/pointer activate once; Windows/macOS system ring versus Win32 persistent keyboard-modality custom ring; ref self-focus and detach/disable obey shared lifetime.
UIA/AX announces resolved role/name/selected/disabled once without glyph/visual duplication; collection semantics remain caller-owned.
Small/medium/large map padding, bodySmall/Medium/Large typography, 16/20/24 icons and 20/32/40 avatars; secondary right versus under changes layout without changing order.
Review secondary wrapping, trailing noninteractive content, native icon/avatar alignment and focus rings for every size on desktop renderers.

limitations: Trailing is presentation only; nested actions are not isolated from root press and are not qualified as independent controls.
No native focus, selected projection, stable measured width or visual execution record is linked.
Collection navigation, typeahead and restoration are outside the standalone contract, not inferred from a row press.
